title: HOSA Meeting
message:
Hi Everyone! Our first HOSA meeting of the year will be held on Friday (9/18) Lunch & Learn 1 in room 243. If you plan on participating in the club this year please be sure to attend so we have an idea of the number of members, and share this code with any friends who may be interested in healthcare and joining the club!
 
Schoology Group Code: GV9G-FBWS-GVQZW
 
At this meeting we will introduce HOSA, event selection, officer elections, and any other additional information that may be helpful! If you have any questions prior to the meeting feel free to email nsunkara01@student.dasd.org or ssrirangam01@student.dasd.org.
 
Thank you and hope to see you there!
